#{batchId}
update food_batch set qty = #{qty}, update_time = sysdate() where batch_id = #{batchId}

update food_batch b join wms_material m on m.material_id = b.material_id left join food_expiry_policy p1 on p1.material_id = b.material_id and p1.status = '0' and p1.del_flag = '0' left join food_expiry_policy p2 on p2.material_id = 0 and p2.material_type = m.material_type and p2.status = '0' and p2.del_flag = '0' left join food_expiry_policy p3 on p3.material_id = 0 and p3.material_type = '' and p3.status = '0' and p3.del_flag = '0' set b.expire_status = case when b.expire_date is null then '0' when b.expire_date < curdate() then '2' when b.expire_date < date_add(curdate(), interval coalesce(p1.warn_days, p2.warn_days, p3.warn_days, 30) day) then '1' else '0' end, b.update_time = sysdate() where b.del_flag = '0' and b.batch_status != '3'

update food_batch b left join wms_material m on m.material_id = b.material_id left join food_expiry_policy p1 on p1.material_id = b.material_id and p1.status = '0' and p1.del_flag = '0' left join food_expiry_policy p2 on p2.material_id = 0 and p2.material_type = m.material_type and p2.status = '0' and p2.del_flag = '0' left join food_expiry_policy p3 on p3.material_id = 0 and p3.material_type = '' and p3.status = '0' and p3.del_flag = '0' set b.expire_status = case when b.expire_date is null then '0' when b.expire_date < curdate() then '2' when b.expire_date < date_add(curdate(), interval coalesce(p1.warn_days, p2.warn_days, p3.warn_days, 30) day) then '1' else '0' end, b.update_time = sysdate() where b.batch_id = #{batchId}
mapper.sql: select g.genealogy_id, g.parent_batch_id, g.child_batch_id, g.relation_type, g.qty, g.qty_unit, g.ref_bill_type, g.ref_bill_id, g.ref_bill_code, g.create_by, g.create_time, g.remark, pb.batch_code as parent_batch_code, cb.batch_code as child_batch_code from food_batch_genealogy g left join food_batch pb on pb.batch_id = g.parent_batch_id left join food_batch cb on cb.batch_id = g.child_batch_id
mapper.insert: insert into food_batch_genealogy (parent_batch_id, child_batch_id, relation_type, qty, qty_unit, ref_bill_type, ref_bill_id, ref_bill_code, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{parentBatchId}, #{childBatchId}, #{relationType}, #{qty}, #{qtyUnit}, #{refBillType}, #{refBillId}, #{refBillCode}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select s.bs_id, s.material_id, s.warehouse_id, s.location_id, s.batch_id, s.qty, s.qty_locked, s.version, b.batch_code, b.batch_status, b.expire_date, b.expire_status, b.qty_unit, wh.warehouse_name, loc.warehouse_name as location_name, mm.material_code as stock_material_code from food_batch_stock s inner join food_batch b on b.batch_id = s.batch_id and b.del_flag = '0' left join wms_warehouse wh on wh.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id left join wms_warehouse loc on loc.warehouse_id = s.location_id left join wms_material mm on mm.material_id = s.material_id where s.material_id = #{materialId} order by b.expire_date asc, s.bs_id asc
select warehouse_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name from wms_warehouse where status = '0' and del_flag = '0' and (node_type = '1' or node_type is null) order by warehouse_id asc limit 1
select shelf_life_days from wms_material where material_id = #{materialId} and del_flag = '0'

select i.inventory_id, i.material_id, i.warehouse_id, i.location_id, i.batch_no, i.production_date, i.expiry_date, i.qty, mm.material_code, mm.material_name, mm.is_expiry_manage, mm.shelf_life_days, mm.unit from wms_inventory i left join wms_material mm on mm.material_id = i.material_id where i.qty > 0 and i.del_flag = '0' order by i.inventory_id
mapper.update: update wms_inventory set batch_no = #{batchNo}, update_by = 'migration', update_time = now() where inventory_id = #{inventoryId}
mapper.select: select d.material_id, d.batch_no, d.issue_qty, d.unit from mms_issue i inner join mms_issue_detail d on d.issue_id = i.issue_id and d.del_flag = '0' where i.work_order_no = #{workOrderNo} and i.status = '1' and i.del_flag = '0' and d.batch_no is not null and d.batch_no != ''

select s.bs_id, s.material_id, s.warehouse_id, s.location_id, s.batch_id, s.qty, s.qty_locked, s.version, b.batch_code, b.expire_date, b.batch_status, b.expire_status, wh.warehouse_name, loc.warehouse_name as location_name, mm.material_code as stock_material_code from food_batch_stock s inner join food_batch b on b.batch_id = s.batch_id and b.del_flag = '0' left join wms_warehouse wh on wh.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id left join wms_warehouse loc on loc.warehouse_id = s.location_id left join wms_material mm on mm.material_id = s.material_id where s.material_id = #{materialId} and s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and s.qty - s.qty_locked > 0 order by (b.expire_date is null) asc, b.expire_date asc, b.batch_id asc
select material_id, material_code, material_name, material_type, is_expiry_manage, shelf_life_days, unit from wms_material where material_id = #{materialId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into food_batch_stock (material_id, warehouse_id, location_id, batch_id, qty, qty_locked, version, create_by, create_time) values (#{materialId}, #{warehouseId}, #{locationId}, #{batchId}, #{qty}, #{qtyLocked}, 0, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update food_batch_stock set qty = #{qty}, qty_locked = #{qtyLocked}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where bs_id = #{bsId} and version = #{version}
mapper.insert: insert into food_batch_status_log (batch_id, batch_code, from_status, to_status, operate_type, reason, ref_bill_type, ref_bill_id, operate_by, operate_time) values (#{batchId}, #{batchCode}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operateType}, #{reason}, #{refBillType}, #{refBillId}, #{operateBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select log_id, batch_id, batch_code, from_status, to_status, operate_type, reason, ref_bill_type, ref_bill_id, operate_by, operate_time from food_batch_status_log where batch_id = #{batchId} order by log_id desc
